Hi Simon — thanks for the clear scope. We can perform the purge and provide attestation artifacts. Below is the proposed workflow and what we'll provide for Boreal's audit: 

1) Intake and verification (within 4 business hours): we will open a ticket (JIRA-OPS-9842) and verify the account identifiers you provided. We may ask for a short signed acknowledgement from your compliance team if the scope touches backups.

2) Scheduling (within 24 hours): schedule a maintenance window for the purge to avoid interfering with live jobs. If you require immediate action, we can run a scoped emergency purge but it will require an on-record waiver.

3) Execution steps (ops):
   - Lock writes for the specified customer IDs to prevent new artifacts during the sweep.
   - Run prefix/KV sweep to clear cached prompt-output & KV entries for identifiers.
   - Expunge runtime inference logs and temporary diagnostic traces matching time range.
   - Remove any derived artifacts from short-term analytics buckets (we will enumerate locations).
   - Reconcile against index/manifest to ensure no residual pointers remain.

4) Evidence package (we will deliver within 72 hours of execution):
   - wipe_manifest_YYYYMMDD.csv (list of removed keys/objects)
   - sanitization_run_YYYYMMDD.log (ops run output; redacted where necessary)
   - proof_of_erasure_YYYYMMDD.pdf (signed attestation with timestamps and operator IDs)

A few clarifying questions so we scope correctly: do you want us to scrub derived embeddings/feature vectors as well, or only raw prompts and outputs? Also — are backups subject to the same purge (if so, which backup tiers)?

I will coordinate with our ops and legal teams and confirm the exact ETA after we align on the backup question.
